_comment: Third-party binaries redistributed inside the AeroGap Windows installer.
Every entry is pinned by version AND sha256. build-staging.ps1 refuses to
continue on a mismatch - this is the supply-chain boundary for an artifact
we hand to customers, so a silent substitution must not be possible.
To bump a version: change the version/url, set sha256 to the value printed
by the build script's mismatch error, and record why in the changelog.

convexBackend.notes: Convex publishes no checksums. Verified against the size reported by the GitHub releases API.

node.notes: Iron LTS. Matches the node:20 base image used by selfhost/Dockerfile so both channels run the same runtime major.

caddy.notes: Apache-2.0. Terminates TLS for the whole stack. REQUIRED, not optional: the Convex backend has no native TLS support (verified - no cert/key flags), and the browser connects to Convex directly, so without a proxy an https app page making http Convex calls is blocked as mixed content.

winsw.notes: MIT. WinSW publishes no checksums; size cross-checked against the GitHub releases API. v2 targets .NET Framework 4.6.1, present on Server 2016+ with no extra install.
